snippet.title: Card City Nights Forever - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
It's cards! It's a city! It's night! And this time it's forever! Card City Nights Forever is the third and final installment of the series, with the best core TCG gameplay yet, a whole new huge 3D adventure, and an online mode that will last forever!  

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475280/Card_City_Nights_Forever/
